notes.title: Added Acheavement
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33815653/53a2ed9b3f7dfd55b78b71b76ab4f844d5375b2e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Achievement is implemented.[/h1]
They are unlocked by clearing the stage in each mode.
Unlocked results can be viewed on the steam client.
These are dedicated to your skill!

[h1]Bug Fixed[/h1]
Fixed a bug that prevented SE from being played back

notes.content:

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]The hidden playmode stage has been opened up with fewer plays.[/b]
[*] [b]Full-screen implemented.[/b]
You can also select multiple screen modes from OPTION.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.9 Update
notes.content:
A new LIGHT MODE was added.
Appear when you play NOMAL MODE more than 3 times.
Also, we implemented up to 6 Way Shot in game SHOP.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33815653/77a44bf02ab3346b6dde586d657b6d9919c2c817.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33815653/1b04abf52964d054f381c0d9b84310233a4ae8b3.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update ver 1.8
notes.content:
We relaxed part of the score cost of in-game effect SHOP.
Fixed that the score position was wrong.
We relaxed the initial invincible effect of S.F. mode.
We implemented 4 way shot on effect SHOP.
